transitions.note: Owner decision 2026-11-11: brisk when lightly loaded, slower with load (x1.4 at 30 kg, x1.6 at 40 kg).

movement.note: Slope effect follows Tobler's hiking function (speed falls exponentially with grade, fastest slightly downhill); load and fatigue penalties are game values.

physiology.note: Owner decision 2026-11-11: a loaded soldier running in the open is clearly winded (fatigue ~0.7) after 2-3 min and recovers in ~5 min of rest; rates chosen to match. Heart-rate range for fit young adults.

hydration.note: M11.6 water (search extracts only, no page opened). fromBattleS 7200: owner decision (water matters only in battles of 2 h or more). lossBaseLph 0.15 L/h at rest, temperate (about 3.6 L/day; USARIEM Montain & Stamm 2000 give 1.5 L/day fixed plus sweat, the US Army 3-4 L/day temperate: medium) plus lossExertLph 0.8 L/h at full exertion (TB MED 507: 0.47 L/h easy work to 0.7-0.95 L/h hard work: medium), times the heat factor of this block. deficitMaxL 4.8 L = 6 % of the 80 kg body (hydration 0) and effectFromL 1.6 L = 2 % (Sawka NBK231132, GSSI Barnes & Baker, PMC8912814: endurance and cognition fall from about 2 % lost; physical work capacity about -20 % at 6-7 %: medium); between them the effects grow linearly. Game values (low, owner to review): he sips sipMl 250 ml from his emptiest canteen when hydration is below drinkBelow 0.85 (a deficit of 0.72 L) and his suppression is at most drinkSuppressionMax 0.1; at a 6 % deficit fatigue builds x(1 + fatigueGainK 1.0), recovers x(1 - recoveryK 0.5) and the aim error is x(1 + aimK 0.3).
